rules.problem: Type right (check task triggered by the complaint), every check_for item traces to a column heading or the HS sub-branch, nothing invented. Low note: Erythema appears three times (plain, Poorly defined, Well defined+Raised), so the nurse must record the qualified form for cellulitis/erysipelas to fire; a modelling consequence, not a page distortion.

AND of red + warm + painful + lump matches 'Red, warm, painful lump'; 'likely' justifies probable. 'May be fluctuant' / 'may discharge pus' are optional on the page and correctly left out. Only caveat is c016 (Furuncle not subsumed by the diagnosis concept).
Pain AND (recurrent abscess at axilla OR groin OR perineum) matches 'If recurrent boils or abscesses: If painful abscesses in axilla, groin or perineum, hidradenitis suppurativa likely'.

summary: No invented, distorted or misplaced content: all 34 conditions trace to the page in the right rule and role, and the absence of a priority evaluation is correct because the red box only redirects to page 82. The one imprecision is the boil/abscess diagnosis concept, which in SNOMED does not subsume Furuncle, so the 'boil' half of 'Boil/abscess likely' is not covered; no single concept fixes this. Outside the backward remit but worth a note for the reconciler: the page's 'Suspected meningitis (headache, temperature >= 38C, neck stiffness)' referral criterion under herpes zoster has no possible-diagnosis rule, and 'Blister of skin' is classified under injury in SNOMED (Vesicle of skin is the dermatological alternative, though further from the page wording).
